newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle actively trade $0.50-$1 lower - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle actively trade $0.50-$1 lower - USDA.

text.p: Trade fairly active. Slaughter steers and heifers $0.50 lower, instances $1.00 lower live basis. Dressed basis trade $1.00 lower, instances $2.00 lower.
Buyer interest generally good, seller interest mixed.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs mostly 63.00, few 63.50-64.00, latter price delivered; Dressed basis mostly 102.00, few 102.50. ( weighted average 102.02 ).
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs mostly 63.00, few 62.50-62.75 and few 64.00 delivered; Dressed basis mostly 102.00, few down to 100.00, few up to 103.00.
Week To Date 37,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk 88,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr 48,700
